lane: AI runtime: sign-in, daily limit and switch for ai-daily-insight and ai-astrology-report
goal: Approved 04/11 and held from the Singapore deploy: ai-daily-insight and ai-astrology-report call a paid model without sign-in or limit. Require a verified non-anonymous sign-in before reading the body (shared guard used by Tarot), honour an emergency switch, and cap each account at 3 model attempts per local day for each function (Owner decision 10/11). The app already falls back to its local text when the call fails, so a refusal never leaves the user empty.
successCriteria: Both functions answer 401 authentication_required without a valid signed-in token, before reading the body, prompt or model.
Both functions answer 503 feature_paused when ai_feature_switches has enabled=false for daily_insight or astrology_report (no row means on; rows need a later migration).
Both functions answer 429 daily_limit_reached once 3 attempts were recorded for that account since local midnight (UTC+7); each allowed call records one attempt event before the model call.
Request body is bounded by the shared guard (32 KB, JSON content type).
Deno tests for the new daily-attempt helper pass; both functions pass deno check.
untouchedSurfaces: No SQL: switch rows for daily_insight and astrology_report need a later migration (until then the switch reads as on).
No app change: backendClient already falls back to local text on any error.
No deploy: the two functions stay held on Singapore until the Owner approves deploying them.

impact.dataWrite: One usage_events row per allowed attempt (daily_insight_attempted, astrology_report_attempted) under existing RLS.
impact.backendContract: Success responses unchanged; new error codes 401 authentication_required, 429 daily_limit_reached, 503 feature_paused/usage_check_unavailable.
impact.adminVisibility: Attempt events visible in usage data; workflow catalog digests refreshed.
impact.privacySafety: No model call or body read before sign-in; anonymous sessions refused.
impact.observability: Existing traces unchanged; attempt events give per-day counts.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; functions are not deployed yet.
